Chronology of every recorded fact about [[rock worm]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== House of Blades ==
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|'''Ch 11''' — A rock worm is a creature in the cave described as being as fat as a cow and made of boulder-like chunks.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|'''Ch 12''' — A giant rock worm's corpse was found in the tunnel.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|'''Ch 12''' — A chamber contains thousands of huge rock-worms tangled together like mating snakes.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|'''Ch 12''' — The cave floor contained giant rock-worms.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|'''Ch 13''' — Rock-worms inhabit a nest and can be woken by movement.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|'''Ch 13''' — Rock-worms have granite eyelids and mouths filled with teeth like obsidian chips.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|'''Ch 13''' — Rock-worms have searing blue eyes the size of two hands.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|'''Ch 14''' — A rock-worm's teeth shredded Simon's pants leg.}}
